Capability Gallery — every renderable kind, one real dataset

WF-301 · doc-system · draft · 2026-08-19
🛡PUBLIC

overview

One working example of every figure kind this engine can render, in a single self-contained HTML document, built through the ordinary python3 -m tools.docgen.cli build path. Nothing here is a mock: every number comes from a real measurement recorded in the Data provenance section below, and every figure carries a reader_question/insight pair (see INTERPRETATION.md).

The dataset is deliberately mundane — the structure of a real, unrelated local directory tree (a credential-vault application, referred to below as the measured tree) surveyed with nothing but find, wc -l, ls and codemap. No file contents were read except line counts over nine JavaScript modules, no credential material was touched, and the tree's secret-bearing directories were excluded from every survey by path. The point is that the engine renders whatever real structure you hand it, and that the numbers on every figure can be re-derived by hand from the commands listed at the end.

Two figures are the exception, and say so on their own captions: a filesystem has no geographic dimension, so the geo-map and choropleth are sourced from this engine's own bundled boundary dataset (tools/docgen/assets/world-countries-110m.geojson) instead.

Data provenance

How every number here can be re-derived

Run these from the root of the measured tree ($TREE). They are read-only and touch no file contents beyond counting lines in nine JavaScript modules.

RefCommand
fs-ext-mixfind . -type f -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./store/*" -not -path "./keys/*" -not -path "./wallets/*" | sed -n 's/.*\.\([A-Za-z0-9]*\)$/\1/p' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
fs-linecountwc -l lib/*.js
fs-dircountENGINE_HOST_ROOT=$TREE node tools/graphify/build.mjs
fs-mtimefind . -type f -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.git/*" -exec stat -f "%Sm" -t "%Y-%m" {} \; | sort | uniq -c
fs-depthfind . -type f -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.git/*" | awk -F/ '{print NF-1}' | sort -n | uniq -c
geojson-110mParse tools/docgen/assets/world-countries-110m.geojson; count geometry parts per feature

The two file-count denominators differ on purpose. fs-ext-mix counts 155 files because it excludes the vault-scoped store/, keys/ and wallets/ directories; fs-mtime and fs-depth count all 198 because path depth and modification month reveal nothing about contents. The Sankey in section 10 reconciles the two figures explicitly.

fs-dircount reports smaller per-directory counts than a bare find for some directories (dev 7 vs 12, wallets 4 vs 5, keys 3 vs 4) because codemap applies its own ignore rules. Figures citing fs-dircount use the codemap numbers throughout; figures citing fs-ext-mix use the find numbers throughout. Neither set is silently mixed.
